method: Exact complete sentence → manually authored scene name and two or three interacting rule IDs. runtimeCoverage: All 483 programs execute in Game.step, with mid-field save/restore across all ten chapter maps and entries (tests/poetry-scenes.test.mjs). Additional assertions inspect real ground-only targeting, native flight geometry, boss/ice resistance, pond residence/reset, route-following waterfall, shield transfer/reflection, three-hit shelter, delayed arrivals, remote range, real targeting priority, harvest caps, ruin actors and invalid snapshots.
